content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate from gateway -> upstream (region: us-west2). Alert group: gateway_high_5xx
anya: taking this on-call. joining bridge now.
anya: quick summary? customer impact?
incident-bot: spike started ~T-3m, 5xx rate up to 7% of requests for some routes. CorrelationID sample: `corr=8a3f9e2b`. Traces: https://traces.internal/wf/8a3f9e2b
renzo: seeing many `upstream_reset` + `413` -> then gateway returns 502/504. Logs attached: (snip)
renzo: grep from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-17T12:01:10Z gateway request_id=abc123 corr=8a3f9e2b upstream=svc-auth timeout_ms=3000
2026-03-17T12:01:11Z gateway request_id=abc124 corr=8a3f9e2b upstream=svc-auth connection_reset
2026-03-17T12:01:12Z gateway request_id=abc125 corr=8a3f9e2b upstream=svc-auth 502
```
anya: thanks. loading tracepack now.
taylor: I see a burst of retries from our edge LB to svc-auth -> concurrent connections spike. Could be retry amplification.
kevin: svc-auth pods are spiking OOM/killing? kube events show rapid restarts around T-2m.
peter: customer impact: support fed a couple of incidents - 12 customers reported errors, most on search routes.
anya: hypothesis 1: upstream (svc-auth) transiently slowed -> client retries from frontend + gateway retries -> queueing -> gateway timeouts.
anya: hypothesis 2: an autoscaler misconfiguration caused slow pod spinups -> cold start backlog (less likely but possible)
renzo: evidence for 1: traces show repeated `POST /auth` with same `corr` id from different gateway workers within 1s window.
renzo: example trace steps: `gateway -> svc-auth (retry) -> gateway -> svc-auth (retry)`
kevin: we've got CPU throttle events on svc-auth host nodes around T-3m. correlates with noisy neighbor on that AZ.
anya: mitigation idea: temporarily disable gateway automatic retries on affected route, and increase upstream timeout to 6s to avoid cascade. Rollback after stabilization.
anya: can ops run the quick config change? command in infra repo:
```
PATCH /config/gateway/routes
- path: /auth
  retries: 2
+ path: /auth
  retries: 0
  timeout_ms: 6000
```
peter: thumbs up from support if we can reduce customer-facing errors.
sre-rotation: I'm applying the patch to canary cluster now, will promote if green.
sre-rotation: applied to canary @ 3789991310, monitoring.
renzo: canary shows gateway 5xx down from 7% -> 1.2% in 30s. traces show fewer duplicate corr replays.
anya: good. promote to prod in 2 steps: prod-edge canary, then full.
sre-rotation: promoting to prod-edge @ 3789991365.
sre-rotation: promo success, applying to other edge nodes.
kevin: svc-auth pod restarts slowed after noisy neighbor throttled (infra team applied node-level QoS). Noting both mitigations in play.
anya: customer impact update: error reports down to 3 customers, no new tickets in last 10m. Notifying CS.
peter: posting short note to status page: "degraded: elevated 5xx on auth routes, mitigation in progress". Keeping monitoring.
anya: next steps: gather full trace bundle, collect gateway + upstream logs for window T-5m..T+5m, assemble timeline, and schedule RCA 0900PT tomorrow.
renzo: saving logs to /dropbox/incidents/3789991234/wf-bundle.tar.gz
anya: add hypothesis tracking in doc: https://docs.internal/incident/3789991234 (skeleton created)
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated -> monitoring. Pager remains assigned to anya.
anya: thanks team. if we see recurrence, we'll re-open with priority. :white_check_mark:
